text:
Harper (Growth): quick triage thread 1 Weekly KPI shows launch-post engagement steady but paid MQLs down ~24% and webinar RSVPs from paid fell too. dropping here for fast sync before the Friday email.
Dmitri (Analytics): looking. quick signal: an increase in conversions with NULL campaign and a bounce spike around 09:00 PT for paid clicks.
Sana (MarOps): I touched campaign normalization rules last Thursday but only for partner feeds, not paid.
Rae (Product Marketing): organic blog ran a headline tweak yesterday; paid creative IDs unchanged.
Dmitri (Analytics): ran a quick query to inspect campaign distribution:
```
SELECT coalesce(utm_campaign,'(none)') as camp, count(*) c
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12;
```
Dmitri (Analytics): seeing a jump in (none) tied to referer host redirector.fastclicks.net. vendor status shows a redirect shim deployed yesterday.
Sana (MarOps): that matches my thread with FastClicks (FC-220). they're rolling a header/param change to 10% of traffic. I'll escalate to ask for rollback.
Harper (Growth): for the KPI email we need defensible numbers. Can BI add a heuristic attribution fallback so we don't undercount paid for the send?
Dmitri (Analytics): yes 1 I'll add heuristic_campaign in the ETL (utm_campaign -> session last-non-null -> referer-domain map) and a small tile showing percent null-by-referer. ETA ~35m to BI.
ndash-bot: dashboard "launch_performance_weekly" updated by Dmitri. https://bi.redwood/d/launch_performance_weekly
Rae (Product Marketing): good. also adding hidden_campaign_server token to reg flow backlog so server captures campaign regardless of client querystrings. low lift.
Sana (MarOps): noted. I'll update FC-220 and add a one-liner to the Friday email: "Attribution cleanup in progress; numbers may adjust."
Harper (Growth): owners: Sana -> vendor escalation + email note; Dmitri -> ETL heuristic + dashboard tiles; Rae -> hidden token backlog; Harper -> re-run WoW and finalize KPI email.
Dmitri (Analytics): will post interim adjusted snapshot when ETL lands.
Harper (Growth): thanks team :thumbsup: small ops catch will keep the launch narrative clean for execs.
